report.description: HubSpot offers a comprehensive set of REST APIs for managing CRM data such as contacts, properties, and search, enabling read and write operations across the platform.

evidence.claim: Private apps can be created by users to obtain access tokens for API calls.
HubSpot provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI integration.
Developers can set up the MCP server via the HubSpot CLI, enabling AI assistants to interact with HubSpot data.
HubSpot supports OAuth Bearer token authentication for API access.
HubSpot offers extensive CRM APIs covering contacts, companies, deals, and more.
